# Heat pump savings in cold climates

A field study of 412 homes found that delivered heating energy fell by 61 percent \[S1\][^N1] \[S3 p.2\][^N2].

## What the field study measured

Confidence: Medium (Vector's estimate)

The study followed 412 homes through two winters \[S1\][^N1].

## How large the savings were

Confidence: Low (Vector's estimate)

Delivered heating energy fell by 61 percent \[S3 p.2\][^N2].

## Open questions

- How much less do poorly insulated homes save?
